summary.scope: Real modules via ViteSSR; controlled fetch; no network/business writes.

results.name: AI wrapper sends actual endpoint, JSON and bearer header
JSON ProblemDetails503 preserves provider detail instead of offline sample mode
JSON message503 remains a server error with exact status
Gateway HTML503 is offline rather than a fake successful API result
Caller cancellation stays AbortError and does not become offline
Explicit deadline releases a stalled request as TimeoutError
Deadline also covers a stalled response body
Reads use45seconds; writes have no automatic retry or deadline
Multipart keeps the browser Content-Type boundary
Blocked browser storage does not crash the fetch wrapper
Network failure is explicit and is not retried
Business calendar crosses Vietnam midnight regardless of visitor timezone
Booking/refund cutoff uses the exact Vietnam session start
Session completion uses the Vietnam end time
Class date fallback and deletion guard share the center day
All four staff date defaults accept CrudPage(user) invocation
AI accepts real AiReply content and rejects generic HTTP200 error text
AI context excludes pending/failed messages and retains only completed pairs
